name: Referred Document Information 7
definition: Set of elements used to identify the documents referred to in the remittance information.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of referred document.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the referred document.

RelatedDate.name: Related Date
RelatedDate.definition: Date associated with the referred document.

LineDetails.name: Line Details
LineDetails.definition: Set of elements used to provide the content of the referred document line.
